title: Tidal Response and Thermodynamics of Black Holes
summary: In this work, we revisit black hole Love numbers from two complementary perspectives. First, we develop a manifestly gauge-invariant framework that directly integrates out the short-distance degrees of freedom of a static black hole in arbitrary spacetime dimensions. This approach yields the effective point-particle action and its associated Love numbers without relying on the standard matching procedure or on the Regge-Wheeler equation and its associated master field.
